title: Together, We Build Better
summary: For more than 65 years, JELD-WEN has helped create spaces where life unfolds. This isn’t accomplished alone, it takes people, partnerships and shared commitment to make those moments possible.
body_markdown:
A front door swings open on moving day. A contractor wraps up a project after months of planning and collaboration. A family gathers around the table as sunlight streams through the windows of a home they're proud to call their own.


While these moments may look different, they have something in common: none of them happen alone.


Behind every home, renovation and building project is a network of people working together to make it possible. Manufacturers. Builders. Dealers. Distributors. Suppliers. Homeowners. Communities. Each plays a role in creating something meaningful.


At JELD-WEN, that belief has been at the heart of our business for more than 65 years. It's why we're introducing[Together, We Build Better](https://www.corporate.jeld-wen.com/about-us/our-purpose) , a brand platform that reflects who we are, how we work and how we create value every day.


This is not a new slogan. It's a reflection of a simple truth: JELD-WEN has never built anything alone. Our success has always been shaped by the people who make our products, the customers who trust them, the partners who sell and install them, and the communities that support us.


“


JELD-WEN has never built anything alone ”


Over the years, we've manufactured millions of windows and doors, but what matters most isn't just what we've built. It's what those products help make possible. They frame first homes, welcome new neighbors, create gathering places for families and help bring beauty and security to the spaces that touch our lives.


That perspective has shaped the way we think about partnership.


For our customers, success is about more than receiving a quality product. It's about having a reliable partner who understands their business, helps solve challenges and delivers on commitments. For homeowners, it's about confidence in the products that become part of their everyday lives.


Together, We Build Better captures those connections.


It recognizes that lasting value is created when people work toward a shared goal. When we invest in our teams, we strengthen our partnerships. Strong partnerships create better experiences for customers and homeowners. Those experiences help build stronger communities and create long-term value for everyone involved.


Together, We Build Better also reflects the values that guide JELD-WEN every day: building our business ethically and safely, investing in people, inspiring customers through innovation, delivering on our promises and improving every day. These principles shape how we operate, how we serve customers and how we grow together.


As we look ahead, Together, We Build Better will help tell a more complete story about JELD-WEN. One that goes beyond products and highlights the people, partnerships, craftsmanship and accountability that have defined our company for decades.


Because the best things we build have never been windows or doors alone. They're trust. Relationships. Opportunity. Places to belong. And we've always built them together. Together, We Build Better.
